# Bitmap Layer

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Render a raster image at specified boundaries.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{ "id": "n1", "op": "bitmap", "name": "bitmap", "x": 0, "y": 0, "params": {} }
```

One out of it starts at `"sourcePort": "layer"`; a parameter is set in `params` (leave out the ones at their default), driven by an edge to `par:desaturate`, or read elsewhere as `ch('bitmap/desaturate')`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
This operator has no input ports.
<!-- gen:end inputs -->
